title: US unveils sanctions on ICC in move court condemns as 'assault on rule of law'
content: Several member states of the international tribunal, including the UK, say they "strongly disagree" with the sanctions.

title: Navi Pillay, former UN human rights chief, wins Nobel Peace Prize
content: Pillay is recognised for her "efforts to promote peace and international law", the Norwegian Nobel Committee says.

title: JD Vance casts doubt on firing squad execution and says he will not watch it
content: The planned execution of Nidal Hasan by firing squad would be the first military execution in more than 60 years.

title: Katie Zacharia ‘offered’ position as White House press secretary
content: The role has been vacant since former White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt left in August.

title: ‘Barbaric’: US lawmakers condemn plan to livestream Nidal Hasan’s execution
content: Republican and Democratic lawmakers condemn Pentagon plan to livestream Fort Hood shooter's execution by firing squad.

title: AI deepfake ads grow more popular in US midterm campaigns, blurring truth
content: The US midterm election campaign has been filled with political ads featuring AI deepfakes that can mislead voters.
